headlines.description: — The Denver Broncos are atrocious on offense, depleted on defense and shaky on special teams. All they do is find ways to win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos beat the Seahawks 17-14 in OT on Ja'Quan McMillian's pick, Wil Lutz's 53-yarder
